item.title: Tracking measles cases in the United States
item.description: Measles cases are rising in the US due to low vaccination rates and increased travel, with the potential to lose its measles elimination status if outbreaks continue for a year or more. The post Tracking measles cases in the United States appeared first on The Atlanta Voice.

item.title: Why the mid-30s are a major turning point for men’s heart health
item.description: A new study following over 5,000 adults from young adulthood found that men develop cardiovascular disease about seven years earlier than women, and experts advise both men and women to monitor their heart health in early adulthood and to see their doctor regularly. The post Why the mid-30s are a major turning point for men’s heart health appeared first on The Atlanta Voice.

item.title: Atlanta Braves are headed south for spring training, new promo items on tap for 2026 season
item.description: The Atlanta Braves loaded up trucks with gear for spring training on Monday, February 2, and also previewed some of the promotional giveaways scheduled for the 2026 season, including a replica Dale Murphy jersey, bobbleheads of former Braves players, and the new "Crossover Collection" of jerseys. The post Atlanta Braves are headed south for spring training, new promo items on tap for 2026 season appeared first on The Atlanta Voice.

item.title: The Devil Is Busy: Spelman College screens Oscar-Nominated short on abortion access
item.description: Spelman College hosted a screening of the HBO documentary short "The Devil Is Busy" followed by a Q&A with director Christalyn Hampton and executive producer Soledad O'Brien, which follows Tracii, the head of security at Feminist Women's Health Center in Atlanta, as she navigates the daily reality of the clinic amidst legal restrictions and protests. The post The Devil Is Busy: Spelman College screens Oscar-Nominated short on abortion access appeared first on The Atlanta Voice.

item.title: Georgia Senate Public Safety Committee holds Anti-squatting Act hearing
item.description: House Bill 61, known as the "Georgia Anti-Squatting Act of 2026", aims to hasten the removal of unauthorized occupants from residential properties, hotels, and cars, allowing immediate lockouts and treating nonpayment as criminal trespass, which housing rights advocates argue could harm low-income, long-term residents in extended-stay hotels. The post Georgia Senate Public Safety Committee holds Anti-squatting Act hearing appeared first on The Atlanta Voice.

item.title: Atlanta’s Barlow’s breakfast brand makes history at NMAAHC museum store
item.description: Barlow's, a premium breakfast brand founded by Atlanta entrepreneur Tiffani Neal, has been selected for retail placement in the museum store of the National Museum of African American History and Culture in Washington, D.C. The post Atlanta’s Barlow’s breakfast brand makes history at NMAAHC museum store appeared first on The Atlanta Voice.

item.title: Join the 404 Run on April 4, 2026: Celebrate Atlanta’s spirit
item.description: The 404 Run, a 4.04-mile community run celebrating Atlanta culture, will debut on April 4, 2026 at Pittsburgh Yards, bringing together runners, walkers, and neighbors to celebrate movement, identity, and hometown pride. The post Join the 404 Run on April 4, 2026: Celebrate Atlanta’s spirit appeared first on The Atlanta Voice.

item.title: Small Businesses are at the forefront of Atlanta’s mind ahead of FIFA World Cup
item.description: Atlanta Mayor Andre Dickens and business leaders announced resources and grants to help Atlanta entrepreneurs prepare for and participate in the 2026 FIFA World Cup, including the Showcase Atlanta marketing grant program, the Showcase Atlanta Youth Entrepreneurship Accelerator, and the Atlanta Business Readiness Loan Fund. The post Small Businesses are at the forefront of Atlanta’s mind ahead of FIFA World Cup appeared first on The Atlanta Voice.

item.title: Will Georgia’s Black male vote impact the 2026 election cycle?
item.description: Former State Senator Jason Esteves introduced his Black Men's Agenda during a roundtable event in Atlanta, which included plans for health, wealth, and opportunity, and was attended by over 100 Black men. The post Will Georgia’s Black male vote impact the 2026 election cycle? appeared first on The Atlanta Voice.

item.title: Advocates urge Georgia Lawmakers to fully fund SNAP as federal cost shifts loom
item.description: Civil rights groups, lawmakers, and community advocates gathered at Rand Chapel of Central Presbyterian Church to urge legislators to fully fund the Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP) to reduce food insecurity for families across Georgia. The post Advocates urge Georgia Lawmakers to fully fund SNAP as federal cost shifts loom appeared first on The Atlanta Voice.
